svg.title: Generic Kinase Domain
svg.desc: Original connected unequal-lobed kinase domain schematic with an open catalytic cleft, a short peptide cue and a separate abstract phosphate symbol. No named structure, residue identity, reaction kinetics or measured activity is implied.
